package.description: Keeps AI coding agents' per-project histories tethered to their folders

en-US.description: Keeps AI coding agents' per-project histories tethered to their folders
en-US.longDescription: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot and Kimi keep per-project conversation history keyed to the folder's absolute path, so moving, renaming, nesting or copying a project folder orphans it. aht drops one identity marker in each folder, watches for moves and copies, and re-links every agent's history (asking first). It also backs histories up, restores them wherever a folder ends up, and badges managed folders. It can also continue a project in another agent (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, Antigravity or Mistral Vibe) and hand it over to another Mac, Linux machine or Windows PC.
en-US.name: agent-history-tether
